tale_honey.name: Comb Honey
tale_honey.description: Mr Coram's, from last year, in a jar with a paper lid. Eaten off a knife, it heals a little.

tale_crepe.name: Black Crepe
tale_crepe.description: A strip of black crepe, long enough to go round three hives. Miss Hanney cut it off something and did not say what.

tale_walk_plate.name: Dinner Plate
tale_walk_plate.description: Mrs Pollard's good plate, with a blue rim. Wiped clean, the knife and fork laid across it.

tale_horace.name: Horace
tale_horace.description: A tortoise, ninety years old and heavier than he looks. However he is held, he turns his head to the north.

tale_diver_key.name: Chest Key
tale_diver_key.description: A small iron key, cold from being under a stone. The bow is stamped CO.

tale_spanner.name: Diver's Spanner
tale_spanner.description: A spanner as long as your forearm, sized for the wing nuts on a diving helmet.

tale_chit.name: Company Chit
tale_chit.description: GOLDSKIN MINING Co. DIVER DENHOLM TO SURFACE AND REPORT. It has been folded and unfolded until the folds are soft.

tale_scarf.name: Short Scarf
tale_scarf.description: Odd ends of Mrs Wakes's wool, knitted up short. Your name is worked into one corner in the darker wool.

tale_lamp_oil.name: Lamp Oil
tale_lamp_oil.description: A can of paraffin, a third full. Enough to fill one signal lamp.

tale_scrag.name: Scrag End
tale_scrag.description: Neck of mutton in newspaper. Mr Sorrell's own dinner, he says.
